text:
Nora (CEO): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands, leaving answers for the remaining hiring/org questions we didn't have time for.
Ilan (People Ops): Are the Q2 headcount cuts final or is there still room for appeals?
Nora (CEO): Cuts are scoped but not locked. Managers can submit appeals with business impact and mitigation plans by next Tue. We'll review in the Q2 headcount sync.
Samir (Head Eng): For teams asked to lose headcount, what's the plan for prioritizing work? Roadmap tradeoffs?
Nora (CEO): Product leads + Eng leads will align on scaled-back commitments. We'll publish a reduced-scope playbook and a prioritization template in #all-hands-docs.
Ruth (Recruiting): For open offers: if a candidate accepted but the role is rebalanced, do we honor offer or convert?
Ilan (People Ops): Offers already accepted before official rebalancing will be honored. If a role is repurposed before acceptance, we'll coordinate with Hiring Managers for either conversion or an uplift.
Ana (Product): Will managers be allowed to reallocate their own headcount to cover infra needs or is central approval required?
Ilan (People Ops): Managers can propose intra-team reassignments with receiving manager sign-off. Cross-cost-center or permanent transfers need People Ops approval.
Jae (Manager): Any change to the promotion cadence because of the restructure? I have two promo packets in flight.
Ilan (People Ops): No change to cadence. Packets in flight will be processed as-is; new packets will reference the updated band language once published.
Samir (Head Eng): Are we making exceptions to the hiring bar to move faster?
Nora (CEO): No exceptions to the bar. We can increase contractor support and accelerate interview timelines for critical roles, but quality remains.
Ruth (Recruiting): If a req is converted (product -> infra), does referral bonus still apply?
Ilan (People Ops): Referral bonus applies when net-new headcount is created on payroll. Converted reqs (no net-new) do not qualify. We'll update the referral doc.
ops-bot: Reminder: file OrgOps requests via /forms/org-ops by Mon EOD for Q2 planning.
Ana (Product): Can we get a per-pod headcount snapshot? That would help prioritize which roles to keep.
Ilan (People Ops): Yes 1 live headcount matrix is being updated and will be posted in #all-hands-docs within 24h. We'll include a diff since last quarter.
Jae (Manager): For folks moving into central teams, who owns performance reviews during transition?
Nora (CEO): Receiving manager takes day-to-day. Origin manager stays in the loop for promotion calibration that quarter. We'll outline the handoff process in the migration playbook.
Ruth (Recruiting): For critical infra hires, ping me with the job link and I'll reassign a sourcer. Use tag "infra-critical" in Greenhouse.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Headcount appeal office hours" 1 Fri 10:00am PT.
Ilan (People Ops): We'll run two leveling calibration sessions next week for L4-L5 expectations. Invites dropping shortly.
Nora (CEO): Thanks all 44d. If you have urgent edge cases (offers/promos/cross-budget swaps) DM Ilan + Ruth and mark subject "URGENT". Leaving thread open for follow-ups.
